children: may extend loss into a range of $89.82-$91.12 per barrel, as suggested by a Fibonacci ratio analysis.
A retracement analysis on the uptrend from $91.12 to $114.27 reveals a break below the 86.4% level of $94.27, the last barrier towards $91.12.
A projection analysis on the uptrend from $75 marks a similar target of $89.82, the 100% level. A channel technique suggests the target zone of $89.82-$91.12.

Resistance is at $95.48, a break above which could lead to a gain into the $97.22-$98.97 range. On the daily chart, the current fall could be either a correction against the uptrend from $69.79 or a continuation of the downtrend from $126.41.
A retracement analysis suggests a further fall to $88.26, while a projection analysis on the presumed wave C from $118.13 indicates a target zone of $83.25-$89.91.
